title: Small steps: One direction the body can use
categoryContext: Early years and first school transitions
stageSummary: Use the voice safety needs, then teach, reconnect and preserve dignity.
pressureLine: How many times do I have to tell you?
possibleWeather: Young children may hear a pressured sentence as a message about who they are. Keep the language short, concrete and close to the next action.
boundary: The action still needs to happen.
practice: give one concrete direction and wait for it
principle: Match the number of words to the child's capacity in the moment.
nextSentence: The action still needs to happen. First, give one concrete direction and wait for it.
keyLearning: Match the number of words to the child's capacity in the moment.
